overview.description: The Canary HBAR ETF (HBR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long hbar, short usd currency. The fund provides exposure to the daily price movements, net of expenses, of the HBAR, the native digital asset of the Hedera Network, in an ETF structure. The Custodian primarily holds HBAR cold storage (offline). HBR was launched on Oct 28, 2025 and is issued by Canary.
